decisions.quote: In sum, the results of this DAR indicate that there are some indicators considering the problems in money priming literature as suggested by Vadillo et al. (2016) (but at the same time, as not all claims are replicated, it can be concluded that this depends on a set of studies that are examined and a type of analysis).
decisions.reason: The replication evaluates 13 claims from Vadillo et al. (2016), replicating 7 and failing to replicate 6, with the overall summary concluding that some indicators are supported while not all claims are replicated; the shipped coding isolated a single failed claim (Trace 22) rather than coding the paper-level outcome.
